scenes.title: The plan
scenes.vo: Here's the plan. First, the key ideas. Then, a worked example, step by step. Then, your checklist. And finally, a three-question quiz.
scenes.cap: Here's the plan. First, the key ideas. Then, a worked example, step by step. Then, your checklist. And finally, a three-question quiz.

scenes.title: Key ideas
scenes.vo: First, Buckets: liquidity reserve times core (simple, durable) , productive (L.P., vaults, carry) , speculative (new, points, experiments). Next, Concentration caps: per protocol, per chain, per stablecoin issuer, per bridge. Then, Genuine diversification: two front ends on the same protocol, or two stablecoins with the same backing, are one risk, not two. And finally, Rebalancing rules: thresholds that trigger moving money between buckets.
scenes.cap: First, Buckets: liquidity reserve · core (simple, durable) · productive (LP, vaults, carry) · speculative (new, points, experiments). Next, Concentration caps: per protocol, per chain, per stablecoin issuer, per bridge. Then, Genuine diversification: two front ends on the same protocol, or two stablecoins with the same backing, are one risk, not two. And finally, Rebalancing rules: thresholds that trigger moving money between buckets.

scenes.title: Worked example
scenes.vo: Rebalance when any bucket drifts more than 5 points from target, or after any incident. Reserve, 15%, Stablecoins split across 2 issuers, instant access, n/a. Core, 45%, Blue-chip stable lending (2 protocols), ETH staking, 20%. Productive, 30%, Wide concentrated L.P., a vault, a P.T., 10%. Speculative, at most 10%, Points, new protocols, 5%.
